choosePeople: Chunein kis ne payment ki aur kis ko mili.
differentPeople: Payment karne aur lene wala alag hona chahiye.
needBalances: Is payment ko check karne ke liye server ke balances chahiye.
directionWarning: Yeh payment maujooda qarz ki simt se match nahi karti. Naye balances check karein.
creditWarning: Maujooda payable balance se zyada {{amount}} hai, jo credit ban jayega.
recordQuestion: Bahar ki gayi payment record karein?
confirmation: {{from}} ne {{to}} ko {{amount}}, {{date}} (UTC) ko Tally Stick se bahar diye. {{effect}} Tally Stick sirf record karta hai; paise transfer nahi karta.
warningConfirmation: {{from}} ne {{to}} ko {{amount}}, {{date}} (UTC) ko Tally Stick se bahar diye. {{warning}} {{effect}} Tally Stick sirf record karta hai; paise transfer nahi karta.
suggestedHint: Simplify debts par mabni. Tally Stick is group mein har member ka kul hisaab rakhta hai, yeh nahi ke kis ne kis ko dena hai. Aap ki tasdeeq se pehle kuch record nahi hota.
unbalanced: Group ke balances ka majmua zero nahi hai.
noSuggestions: Aap ke liye koi payment nahi sujhai gayi.
restored: Aap ka saved payment draft wapas aa gaya. Log aur raqam check karein.
revision: Save karne se naya revision banta hai; history rehti hai.
twoMembers: Bahar ki payment ke liye do active members chahiye.
externalOnly: Woh paise record karein jo kahin aur diye ya liye ja chuke hain. Tally Stick paise transfer nahi karta.
openLedger: Active group ya dost ke khate se Record payment kholein.
discardDraftBody: Is device se saved payment ki tafseel mit jayegi.
recordedOnly: Sirf record hai. Yeh payment Tally Stick se bahar hui thi.
deletedBody: Yeh record Tally Stick ki audit history mein rahega aur ab balances par asar nahi dalega.
deleteBody: {{from}} se {{to}} ko di gayi payment ({{amount}}) mita dein? Balances par iska asar ulat jayega. Tally Stick se bahar diye gaye paise wapas nahi honge.
deleteLedgerBody: {{ledger}} mein {{from}} se {{to}} ko di gayi payment ({{amount}}) mita dein? Balances par iska asar ulat jayega. Tally Stick se bahar diye gaye paise wapas nahi honge.
conflict: Apni edits rakhein ya naya revision load karein. Load karne se is form ki values badal jayengi.
discardBody: Aap ki tabdeeliyan save nahi hui hain. Recorded history waisi hi rahegi.
onlyRecorder: Sirf active payment record karne wala usay edit kar sakta hai.
